meta.title: UniqueGroupsView

fields.name: groupId
fields.mapping: Signal Captured.groupId — empty/absent represents the permanent 'None' row

fields.name: groupName
fields.mapping: GroupsView.name (looked up by groupId), or literally 'None' when groupId is empty

fields.name: assignedProject
fields.mapping: latest:Signal Assigned To Project.projectId for this groupId's most recent signal

meta.description: Rows are hidden once receivedAt <= the latest SignalsArchived.archivedUpTo, same visibility rule as SignalsListView — pressing 'Done' on this grouped-by-group screen fires the same ArchiveSignals command. The 'None' row (signals with no WhatsApp group, i.e. direct messages) is always sorted first regardless of recency; remaining rows sort by latestReceivedAt descending. A row's badge shows a grey '?' instead of a project number/colour when its signals span more than one assigned project.
